claims.text: A 17-year-old male with IgE-mediated peanut allergy and eczema presented with acute dysphagia after eating beef. Esophagram showed a complete mid-esophageal food impaction, which was removed endoscopically; EREFS was 4 and biopsies showed only rare (<5) eosinophils with basal cell hyperplasia and intercellular edema. After resolution he was started on a high-dose proton-pump inhibitor and re-scoped 12 weeks later (EREFS 2, 55 eosinophils/HPF, confirming EoE); after topical budesonide slurry was added he entered histological remission.
